messages:
sam: heads-up, mkdocs linkcheck failed on the migration branch. lots of 404s for fragment links after the mdx switch.

ci-bot: build: docs/mkdocs: linkcheck failed (exit 2). errors: 12 broken links. details: https://ci.redwood/example/5600 :warning:

rachel: sample from the log: 
```
WARNING: broken link: ../guides/configuration#build-flags -> 404
WARNING: broken link: ../api/serve#kv-cache -> 404
```

miguel: pattern i've seen: headings with inline code or emojis get slugified differently in the new parser. also headings followed immediately by an HTML comment sometimes drop the anchor.

sam: do we have a policy on explicit ids? i'd prefer adding them for stable anchors on pages we link from other docs.

rachel: agreed. i'll make a tiny PR that adds `{#...}` ids to the files referenced in the log instead of mass-changing everything. keeps the diff reviewable.

miguel: if you're editing, prefer using ascii-only ids and kebab-case. examples: `## KV cache tips {#kv-cache}` or `## Build flags {#build-flags}`. those are mkdocs friendly.

rachel: working on it. also adding a note to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md recommending explicit ids when headings contain code/emoji/non-ascii.

ci-bot: note: linkcheck will run after PR pushes. re-run queued when ready.

sam: for verification: run locally:
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs build
mkdocs linkcheck --fail-on-broken
```
open the site locally to verify anchor jumps.

miguel: i pushed a branch `docs/mkdocs-anchor-fixes` with 6 small edits and a helper script `scripts/verify_anchors.py` that cross-references linkcheck output to headings. it only touches the files listed in CI.

rachel: thanks. left a minor nit about one id name in the PR. otherwise looks good.

docs-bot: suggestion: add a CI job that parses mkdocs linkcheck output and posts failed anchors as a comment on PRs. reduces manual triage. filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/212 for tracking.

sam: good call. after we merge this i can prototype the bot for the next sprint.

ci-bot: re-run started for PR 4352...

(last) rachel: merge on green please. i'll watch the staging deploy and post here when the prod site has rebuilt. :+1:
